Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is a global technology company that builds infrastructure for online commerce with a mission to increase the GDP of the internet. Through Bridge, Stripe is building stablecoin infrastructure that helps businesses move, store, and use money globally. This role will support Bridge as it develops and scales products for companies operating across markets. 

What you’ll do

Stripe is looking for an exceptional transactional lawyer to join our commercial legal team supporting Bridge and Stripe’s fast-growing stablecoin business.

Responsibilities

  • Support Bridge’s commercial team, leading negotiations for complex and strategic user and partner agreements.
  • Advise on commercial and legal issues arising from stablecoin products, new product launches, and international expansion.
  • Work closely with Product Legal and Bridge’s product and engineering teams to bring new products and features to market.
  • Help build Bridge’s commercial legal infrastructure so the business can scale efficiently, including drafting and maintaining agreements and playbooks, improving internal processes, and using AI tooling to optimize how we work with clients, partners, and users.
  • Partner with teams across Bridge and Stripe globally, including commercial, operations, product, engineering, tax, compliance, and risk.
  • Help the team provide practical, scalable legal support while working collaboratively across a global Commercial Legal team.
  • Develop and deliver training and resources to help Bridge’s commercial team sell and support its products.
  • Be a point of escalation for outside counsel.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Intellectually curious and a creative problem solver - Bridge’s products and the stablecoin industry are complex and fast evolving - you should relish learning new products and finding practical solutions to challenging problems.
  • A self-starter with a bias for action - you are proactive and have a strong sense of ownership. 
  • A clear and concise communicator (in written and verbal forms), who can distill the key risks and explain complex, nuanced issues in plain and simple terms. 
  • A natural collaborator, able to guide cross-functional teams and drive to a win-win solution.
  • Familiar with the legal issues and commercial risks arising from fintech, stablecoin, hosted data, and technology services.
  • A team player who is willing to do what it takes to contribute to the collective success. 
  • Qualified with good standing membership in at least one US state bar with a JD degree or foreign equivalent.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in-house or in a technology practice group in a top law firm.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in payments, fintech, crypto, or stablecoin businesses and knowledge of associated regulatory issues.
  • In-house experience advising high-growth companies.
  • Working knowledge of LLM tools.
  • Experience in improving legal processes with AI technology.
  • A working knowledge of data protection laws such as CCPA, GDPR, and HIPAA.

Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

GM, Head of Data

We are seeking someone to lead the Talos data business and position it for strong, sustainable growth. You’ll own the P&L, product strategy and client relationships for our digital assets data offering, built on the Coin Metrics acquisition. Working closely with engineering, sales and executive leadership, you’ll shape how our data products are built, packaged and taken to market. This is a high-ownership role for an experienced business leader who has built or run a data business before and believes digital assets are where markets are heading.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the P&L for the data business, including revenue, costs, forecasting and performance reporting to executive leadership.

  • Set and execute product strategy: decide where to invest, what to scale and what to sunset, based on product traction and market demand.

  • Build a commercial model that serves both self-service customers and enterprise clients, including packaging, pricing and distribution.

  • Lead the research, product and data science teams, making sure research drives product development and supports Talos more broadly.

  • Partner with sales, marketing and engineering, which sit outside your reporting line, to align priorities and deliver revenue growth.

  • Own client outcomes and account health, resolving issues and driving retention and expansion.

  • Define the positioning and brand strategy for the data business within the wider Talos group.

  • Build a high-performing, motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and shared identity.

 

Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading a business unit or owning a P&L, ideally at a market data, index or financial data provider.

  • A track record of turning around or growing a business, with clear, measurable results.

  • Strong data product expertise, including monetisation, packaging, pricing and go-to-market for both self-service and enterprise models.

  • A background in capital markets. Digital assets experience is a plus, but a strong understanding of and conviction about the asset class is essential.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver through cross-functional teams without direct authority.

  • Experience building and leading research, product or data science teams.

  • Sound commercial judgement and accurate forecasting.

  • Executive presence and the ability to engage and constructively challenge senior leadership.

  • A builder’s mindset, suited to fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments rather than established incumbents.

Benefits

We are looking for a commercially ambitious and highly autonomous seller who can balance near-term revenue delivery with the long-term relationship building required to grow a strategic book of business.   • Own a named portfolio of existing enterprise customers and develop strategic account plans to grow Stripe’s revenue, product adoption, and market share.

  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans across complex organisations with multiple business units, stakeholders, or subsidiaries.
  • Strong experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through commercial negotiation, activation, go-live, and continued growth.
  • Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value and engage confidently with senior business and technical stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leaders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company

Work with the Best

Orderly Network is a combination of an orderbook-based trading infrastructure and a robust liquidity layer offering spot and perpetual futures orderbooks. Unlike traditional platforms, Orderly doesn’t have a front end; instead, it operates at the core of the ecosystem, providing essential services to projects built on top of it.
Our DEX white-label solution is carefully crafted to save builders time and capital while granting access to our bootstrapped liquidity. Picture having the best features of CEXs while keeping settlements on-chain and maintaining full self-custody.

With Orderly, anyone can create a trading application thanks to our seamless plug-and-play experience leveraging our liquidity and composability.

Looking ahead, our grand vision is to create an omnichain protocol, connecting traders from both EVM and non-EVM chains within the same orderbook.

A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network

Orderly's Partnership team accelerates the growth of our ecosystem by identifying, engaging, and supporting builders and partners who build on top of Orderly's infrastructure. In this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding our partner ecosystem — building and managing a robust pipeline of prospective partners, tracking relationship progress through structured CRM workflows, and ensuring partners are activated and growing on Orderly.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in systems — who can apply internet-era frameworks (funnel management, data-driven tracking, automated workflows) to relationship building and pipeline management at scale.

  • What will you be working on?
    • Identify and engage prospective partners across English-speaking markets, prioritizing relationships that can generate trading activity, trading volume, and long-term business value. 
    • Build relationships with project teams, trading communities, affiliates, KOLs, brokers, exchanges, and other relevant partners to develop scalable acquisition channels.

    • Develop and execute partnership initiatives across English-speaking markets, taking local market dynamics and business opportunities into account.
    • Track partner performance and evaluate the impact of partnerships on trading volume, user acquisition, revenue, and other relevant business metrics.
    • Maintain an accurate partner database and use CRM tools, spreadsheets, and structured follow-up processes to manage opportunities efficiently.
    • Work with Marketing, Product, Operations, and BD colleagues to execute growth initiatives and improve partner activation and retention.
    • Monitor industry developments, identify emerging opportunities, and continuously refine outreach and partnership strategies.
  • About you
    • 2+ years of relevant experience in crypto BD, partnerships, affiliate growth, or business development at a trading platform or related business.
    • Professional English proficiency is required, including the ability to communicate effectively with international partners in business discussions and negotiations.
    • An established and actionable network of project teams, trading communities, affiliates, KOLs, brokers, or other relevant partners.
    • Evidence of business impact: You can explain how your previous work generated trading volume, activated partners, acquired users, or contributed to revenue.

    • A strong sense of ownership: You are proactive, entrepreneurial, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment.
    • Excellent communication and follow-through: You can manage multiple stakeholders, set clear expectations, and maintain consistent follow-up.
    • A collaborative approach: You work effectively with cross-functional teams while taking responsibility for your own goals and deliverables.
  • Nice to have
    • Experience in CEX, DEX, perpetual futures, CFD, or other trading-related businesses.
    • A demonstrated ability to bring in active traders, trading volume, or high-value strategic partners.
    • Established relationships and strong market knowledge in English-speaking markets.
    • Experience building partnerships across multiple regions or market segments.

Interested in Learning More?

  • Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues.
  • If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus.

The Business Operations team sits within Finance and partners across Chainalysis to strengthen how the company plans, makes decisions, and executes. Combining analytical rigor with practical operating judgment, the team helps leaders translate company priorities into clear plans, effective operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes. As Chainalysis continues to evolve, Business Operations also helps build the processes and ways of working that enable teams to scale and adapt.

You’ll join a close-knit team working with partners across Finance, R&D, go-to-market, Legal, Security, and beyond. The team takes on high-priority work across the business, often creating structure where approaches are still taking shape, and helps teams align and move change forward. This role offers broad exposure to Chainalysis and the opportunity to help shape how the company operates through its next stage of growth.

In this role, you’ll:

As a Senior Business Operations Analyst at Chainalysis, you will be a strategic operator and connective tissue across leadership and functions - helping translate company priorities into clear plans, operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes. You’ll partner with leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams to improve how the business plans, makes decisions, and executes.

You’ll support high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end: framing ambiguous problems, developing analyses and recommendations, aligning stakeholders, establishing milestones and governance, and driving follow-through. You’ll help run planning and business review cadences, build KPI reporting and insights, improve processes and systems, and support change initiatives such as pricing and packaging, go-to-market readiness, product launches, and organizational or operating-model changes.

You will also:

  • Identify friction in cross-functional workflows and design scalable processes, tools, and operating mechanisms.

  • Prepare clear, data-informed recommendations and executive-ready materials.

  • Manage multiple work-streams and facilitate alignment across stakeholders, balancing speed, rigor, and effective change management.

We are looking for candidates who have/are:

  • 3–6 years of experience in business operations, strategy and operations, management consulting, finance, program management, or a related field—ideally in a SaaS or technology environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into insights, recommendations, and decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready narratives and materials.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong project and program management skills, including prioritization, stakeholder management, and attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with business intelligence, data, and collaboration tools; experience with Jira, Confluence, Databricks, spreadsheets, SQL, and/or AI-powered tools is a plus.

  • Ability to drive clarity in ambiguity, influence without authority, and demonstrate resilience in a dynamic environment.

  • Curious, adaptable, and motivated to learn quickly, challenge assumptions, and make the company and team better.

Nice to have experience:

  • Business Operations or Strategy & Operations experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

  • Supporting annual or quarterly planning, operating cadences, business reviews, resource allocation, or strategic planning processes.

  • Establishing KPIs, building performance dashboards, and using data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Supporting pricing and packaging, go-to-market or commercialization initiatives, product launches, or broader change-management efforts.

  • Applying agile, lean, or other process-improvement methodologies to scale how teams work.

  • Interest in and general knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency, including key players and market dynamics.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Circle is seeking a highly motivated and accomplished Senior Director of Business Development & Partnerships to lead our expansion and partner ecosystem efforts across MEA. Based in Dubai, with extensive travel across the region, this is a dual-mandate role: you will be both a strategic dealmaker and a dedicated partner owner — identifying and closing high-value opportunities, then ensuring those partnerships are activated, performing, and growing over time.

You will play a pivotal role in shaping Circle's footprint in MEA by leading business negotiations, structuring transformative deals, and owning the ongoing success of strategic partnerships with financial institutions, fintechs, and PSPs. The ideal candidate thrives equally in winning new business and in the disciplined, relationship-driven work of making existing partnerships deliver results. Deep expertise in payments, fintech, and digital assets is essential, as is the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments across the continent.

What You'll Work On

Business Development

  • Develop and execute Circle's business development strategy across Africa, identifying high-impact opportunities to drive adoption of our payment solutions.
  • Lead negotiations and deal structuring for strategic partnerships with PSPs, fintechs, mobile money providers and payments businesses.
  • Develop and validate commercial models for new business opportunities, including financial modelling and forecasting to support strategic decision-making. Apply modern analytics and AI-assisted modeling to improve scenario planning and deal evaluation.
  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies that drive adoption of Circle's existing products and validate new ones, from initial conversations through to signed agreements.
  • Provide market intelligence and feedback to Circle's leadership team to inform product and business strategy. Use a mix of traditional research and AI-augmented tools to synthesize market signals and competitive trends.

Partner Management

  • Own the post-close relationship with strategic partners across MEA, serving as their primary point of contact within Circle.
  • Develop and execute joint business plans with partners, setting clear performance milestones, KPIs, and growth targets.
  • Drive partner activation and time-to-revenue, ensuring smooth onboarding and integration of Circle's products and services.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify gaps, and unlock new growth opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Serve as the internal advocate for partners, coordinating with product, compliance, legal, and marketing teams to resolve issues, surface partner needs, and prioritize the right support.
  • Build and nurture a tiered partner ecosystem across MEA, identifying and developing high-potential partners for deeper, more strategic collaboration.
  • Track and report on partner performance metrics using CRM and analytics tools, ensuring accurate pipeline management and accountability against targets. Leverage AI-augmented CRM features and analytics to improve forecasting, prioritization, and partner insights.

What You'll Bring to Circle

  • 13+ years of experience in business development and/or partner management in financial services, fintech, or digital assets, with a strong track record across the region.
  • Demonstrated ability to both close complex, high-value deals and manage and grow strategic partner relationships post-close.
  • Deep understanding of MEA's financial ecosystem, including mobile money, banking infrastructure, cross-border payments, and emerging fintech trends.
  • A strong network of industry relationships with leading financial institutions, fintechs, and enterprise partners across the region.
  • Proven ability to develop joint business plans, manage partner performance, and drive measurable revenue outcomes through partnerships.
  • Good understanding of the digital assets and cryptocurrency sector, including key players, products, and trends.
  • Practical fluency with modern AI tools and workflows: experience leveraging generative AI and large language models for market research, pitch and contract drafting, data synthesis, and productivity; ability to craft effective prompts and validate model outputs.
